description: This file defines API routes for managing bookings in a gym management system, including creating and canceling class and trainer bookings using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: book_class
methods.description: Creates a booking for a class session.

methods.name: cancel_class
methods.description: Cancels a class booking, accessible by owner or admin.

methods.name: book_trainer
methods.description: Creates a booking for a trainer.

methods.name: cancel_trainer
methods.description: Cancels a trainer booking, accessible by owner or admin.
